title: Policy change confirmation
description: Confirm a change to an insurance policy, like a new address, driver or coverage level, with effective date. Utility WhatsApp template.
notes: List exactly what changed and the effective date; summaries that read like a receipt are reliably categorized as utility.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, we updated policy *{{policy_no}}*: {{change}}. The change takes effect on {{effective_date}}. If this was not you, call us right away.

change.example: added Alex Kim as a driver
